PlannerGuide

PRIVACY & ABOUT

A small tool, with clear limits.

Your inputs stay in this page

The planner runs in your browser. Dish names, oven settings and serving times are not submitted to a server. There are no accounts, advertising scripts, analytics, trackers, cookies or browser-storage features in this site’s code. Reloading or closing the page clears the entered plan. Print the result if you want to keep it.

The hosting provider may process ordinary connection data when delivering the site, such as an IP address and basic request logs. This is distinct from the dish inputs, which the planner does not send. Links to other websites use those websites’ own privacy practices. Printing uses your device’s print or PDF workflow.

What Oven Window is for

Oven Window is an independent, experimental planning utility for people organizing multiple oven dishes. It checks a simplified set of timing, temperature and space constraints and gives a printable action list. It has no affiliation with USDA or any appliance or recipe publisher.

What it does not promise

It is not a recipe source, food-safety assessment, cooking thermometer, alarm or guarantee that dinner will finish on time. Actual cooking varies. Follow tested recipes, appliance instructions and authoritative food-safety guidance. The example values are fictional scheduling inputs, not tested recipes.

The tool searches at one-minute resolution. A search-limit result is inconclusive. Prep time, multiple cooking stages, oven recovery, safe holding, burners and other appliances are outside the model. See the planning guide for details.

Costs and access

The site has no paid features, subscriptions, purchases or sign-up form. No personal information is needed to use the planner.
